raw_segments.text: You don't come to see me, Socrates, as often as you ought.
If I were still able to go and see you I would not ask you to come to me.
But at my age I can hardly get to the city, and therefore you should come oftener to the
For let me tell you, that the more the pleasures of the body fade away, the greater to me is
the pleasure and charm of conversation.
Do not then deny my request, but make our house your resort and keep company with these
We are old friends, and you will be quite at home with us.
